newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sintercast unaware of Morgan stake size.
newsitem.headline: Sintercast unaware of Morgan stake size.

text.p: Swedish engineering company Sintercast said it was surprised at the size of the stake investment bank Morgan Grenfell said earlier it may hold in the company.

"It was a surprise to us that Morgan Grenfell may own as much as 57 percent of Sintercast. We knew they had a large stake but we were unaware that it could be a majority holding," Sintercast Chairman Bo Ramfors told Reuters.

Ramfors said Morgan Grenfell had not been in contact with Sintercast, a highly speculative stock of a company that has developed what it says is a radically cheaper way of producing car engine blocks.
Sintercast's share price has fallen to 275 crowns on Friday from 374 crowns on Monday.
"We are expecting to hear from them soon. Morgan Grenfell has not registered as having a majority stake," he added.
Ramfors said Sintercast would welcome Morgan Grenfell as a majority owner.
